headline: Bring Adax heating into Home Assistant
intro: Connect Adax heaters through a local or cloud interface and manage them from Home Assistant. Newer heaters with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi can be configured locally; cloud setup uses your Adax Account ID and a generated Remote API password. Cloud connections also provide heater energy sensors.
highlights: Choose local setup for newer heaters with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi; the heater must be in Bluetooth range during setup
Use your Adax Account ID and generated Remote API password for cloud setup
Track each heater's energy consumption in Wh with sensors available through the cloud connection

flow.title: Choose a connection for Adax heating
stages: Configure the heater using Bluetooth or Adax cloud credentials
Control the heater in Home Assistant
Use cloud energy sensors to follow consumption
